model_token_policy: Prepared prompt strings and toy-vocabulary tokens are model data, not learner-interface prose; they remain unchanged across locales so localization cannot mutate model arithmetic.

en.page.title: Transformer Language Modeling
en.page.subtitle: Trace a tiny deterministic decoder-like block from toy tokens to causal self-attention to next-token probabilities. Every displayed number is computed locally from fixed teaching weights.
en.boundary.label: Evidence boundary.
en.boundary.text: This is a toy deterministic model, not a pretrained LLM. It does not reproduce GPT, Claude, Gemini, or another frontier model. Its attention weights expose one numeric mixing mechanism; they are not a general explanation of model reasoning or understanding.

en.attention_warning.text: These weights show how this toy head combines value vectors. The largest weight is not automatically the reason for a final output logit.
en.distribution.title: Next-token distribution
en.distribution.description: Columns show token, relative bar, logit, and probability. Temperature rescales fixed logits before softmax; it does not retrain the model or change its learned weights.
en.distribution.top: Top probability: {token} — {percent}%. This is the maximum in the displayed distribution, not a sampled output.
en.attention_calc.title: Self-attention calculation
en.attention_calc.description: The scaled score matrix, causal mask, and post-softmax attention weights are shown separately. Weight cells retain exact numbers, so color intensity is redundant rather than the sole information channel. Permitted weight cells are keyboard-operable buttons.
en.attention_calc.pair_default: Select a permitted attention cell to inspect its source key/value vectors, raw dot product, scaled score, and weight.
en.attention_calc.pair: Destination {destination} @ {i}; source {source} @ {j}. Source key k_j = {key}; source value v_j = {value}. Raw q·k = {raw}; q·k/√dₖ = {scaled}; attention weight = {weight}. {perturbation}
en.challenge.title: Guided Challenges · predict before reveal
en.challenge.1.label: 1 · Highest permitted attention
en.challenge.1.prompt: Fixture: “I like cats.” For the final token cats, which permitted source position receives the largest attention weight?
en.challenge.2.label: 2 · Causal-mask leak
en.challenge.2.prompt: Fixture: “I like cats.” At destination i @ 1, what happens if the causal mask is incorrectly removed?
en.challenge.3.label: 3 · Token substitution
en.challenge.3.prompt: Fixture: replace cats with dogs at the same position in “I like cats.” Which Q/K/V quantities change, and what happens to the next-token probability for sleep?
en.challenge.3.local_increase: Only the substituted position’s Q/K/V change; P(sleep) increases
en.challenge.3.local_decrease: Only the substituted position’s Q/K/V change; P(sleep) decreases
en.challenge.3.all_increase: All positions’ Q/K/V change; P(sleep) increases
en.challenge.4.label: 4 · Temperature transfer
en.challenge.4.prompt: Fixture: keep logits fixed and raise temperature from T=0.5 to T=2.0. What happens to the probability distribution?
en.challenge.committed: Committed prediction: {prediction}. Mechanism remains concealed until Reveal.
en.challenge.1.explain: The ranking comes from scaled query-key dot products followed by softmax, not from a semantic-intention label.
en.challenge.1.transfer: If one query/key component changes, predict which score changes before using the Q/K perturbation scenario.
en.challenge.2.mechanism: With the mask removed, destination i @ 1 assigns {percent}% total attention to later source positions.
en.challenge.2.explain: Autoregressive semantics require that position 1 cannot depend on positions 2 or 3 when predicting from the prefix.
en.challenge.2.transfer: Re-enable the mask and inspect the same row: later cells become structurally unavailable (MASK).
en.challenge.3.mechanism: Earlier-position Q/K/V max Δ = {earlier}; substituted-position Q/K/V max Δ = {changed}. P(sleep): {before} → {after}; Δ = {delta}.
en.challenge.3.explain: At the projection stage only the substituted position’s input changes, so its Q/K/V change while earlier positions’ Q/K/V remain fixed. Downstream attention mixtures and final logits can then change.
en.challenge.3.transfer: Substitute a token at an earlier position and predict which projected row changes before inspecting the matrix.
en.challenge.4.mechanism: Entropy: {cold} at T=0.5 → {hot} at T=2.0. Logits are identical.
en.challenge.4.explain: Dividing fixed logits by a higher temperature reduces their relative separation before softmax, flattening this distribution.
en.challenge.4.transfer: Predict what lowering T below 0.5 would do without changing any model weight.
en.state.title: Accessible numeric state
en.state.description: Text equivalent for the current visualization state.
en.summary.selected: Selected {token} at position {position}. {count} source position(s) permitted. Position vectors {positions}; causal mask {mask}; temperature {temperature}; perturbation {perturbation}.
en.tokenizer.note: Toy tokenizer: {pieces} surface piece(s) + <BOS>; {unknown} unknown piece(s) map to <UNK>{truncation}. This source-locked toy tokenizer is a teaching fixture, not a universal tokenizer.
en.tokenizer.truncation: ; context truncated to {max} tokens while retaining <BOS>
en.scenario.canonical.note: Canonical pipeline: inspect the final token and trace fixed arithmetic from token IDs to the next-token distribution.
en.scenario.qk.note: Perturbation experiment: final query q[0] is increased by 0.50. The cats scaled score changes {score_before} → {score_after} and its attention weight changes {weight_before} → {weight_after}. The perturbation changes arithmetic, not semantic intention.
en.scenario.order.note: Order test: swapping i/like changes the final distribution with positions on (max Δ {with_positions}), while the same swap is invariant in this one-head fixture with positions off (max Δ {without_positions}).
en.scenario.mask.note: Mask leak: at destination i (position 1), removing the mask assigns {percent}% total attention to later source positions. That violates the autoregressive dependency constraint for that position.
en.scenario.temperature.note: Temperature: entropy rises from {cold} at T=0.5 to {hot} at T=2.0 while the logits stay fixed. Higher temperature makes this distribution flatter.
en.scenario.explanation.note: Executable counterexample: for “sleep sleep i,” the largest final-row attention weight is {weight_token}@{weight_position} = {weight}, while the largest finite-ablation effect on the original top-token ({top_token}) logit comes from {impact_token}@{impact_position} = {impact}. The ablation removes one αⱼvⱼ contribution without renormalizing. It is a diagnostic counterexample to “largest attention = reason,” not a complete causal explanation.
en.misconceptions.title: Check your model of the model
en.misconception.1.response: Not generally. This applet uses a deliberately simple source-locked toy tokenizer; unknown words map to <UNK> and a period is its own token.
en.misconception.2.claim: “Attention tells us what the model understands.”
en.misconception.2.response: No. Attention weights are numeric mixing coefficients, not a direct reading of understanding.
en.misconception.3.claim: “The largest attention weight is the reason for the prediction.”
en.misconception.3.response: No. Value vectors, residual paths, the feed-forward transform, and output weights also affect logits.
en.misconception.4.claim: “The transformer searches the internet for the next word.”
en.misconception.4.response: Not here. The applet makes no network request or retrieval call.
en.misconception.5.claim: “The causal mask makes the model forget future words it already saw.”
en.misconception.5.response: The mask is a structural constraint on which source positions a destination may use.
en.misconception.6.response: No. Temperature rescales fixed logits before softmax.
en.misconception.7.claim: “The most probable token is always selected.”
en.misconception.7.response: A probability distribution and a generation selection rule are different.
en.misconception.8.response: No. They contribute position-dependent information to this toy representation.
en.misconception.9.claim: “The model stores complete answers and retrieves them.”
en.misconception.9.response: This applet computes logits from numeric state. Retrieval is a separate mechanism.

zh.page.title: Transformer 语言建模
zh.page.subtitle: 从玩具词元出发，逐步追踪一个小型确定性类解码器模块，观察它如何经过因果自注意力得到下一词元概率。界面显示的每个数值都由固定的教学权重在本地计算。
zh.boundary.label: 证据边界。
zh.boundary.text: 这是一个确定性的玩具模型，不是预训练大语言模型。它并不复现 GPT、Claude、Gemini 或其他前沿模型。这里的注意力权重只展示一种数值混合机制，不能作为对模型推理或理解过程的一般性解释。

zh.attention_warning.title: 注意力不是解释。
zh.attention_warning.text: 这些权重展示这个玩具注意力头如何混合值向量。最大注意力权重并不自动等于某个最终输出 logit 的原因。
zh.distribution.title: 下一词元分布
zh.distribution.description: 各列依次显示词元、相对条形、logit 和概率。温度只是在 softmax 之前对固定 logits 重新缩放；它不会重新训练模型，也不会改变已经学到的权重。
zh.distribution.top: 最高概率：{token} — {percent}%。这是当前分布中的最大概率，不代表一次采样输出。
zh.attention_calc.title: 自注意力计算
zh.attention_calc.description: 缩放分数矩阵、因果掩码和 softmax 后的注意力权重分别显示。权重单元格保留精确数值，因此颜色深浅只是冗余提示，并不是唯一的信息通道。允许使用的权重单元格都可通过键盘操作。
zh.attention_calc.pair_default: 选择一个允许的注意力单元格，查看对应来源的键/值向量、原始点积、缩放分数和注意力权重。
zh.attention_calc.pair: 目标 {destination} @ {i}；来源 {source} @ {j}。来源键 k_j = {key}；来源值 v_j = {value}。原始 q·k = {raw}；q·k/√dₖ = {scaled}；注意力权重 = {weight}。{perturbation}
zh.challenge.title: 引导挑战 · 先预测，再揭示
zh.challenge.1.label: 1 · 最高的允许注意力
zh.challenge.1.prompt: 固定情境：“I like cats.” 对最终词元 cats 而言，哪个允许的来源位置会得到最大的注意力权重？
zh.challenge.2.label: 2 · 因果掩码泄漏
zh.challenge.2.prompt: 固定情境：“I like cats.” 在目标位置 i @ 1，如果错误地移除因果掩码，会发生什么？
zh.challenge.2.future: 后面的来源位置会参与计算
zh.challenge.3.label: 3 · 词元替换
zh.challenge.3.prompt: 固定情境：在“I like cats”中的同一位置把 cats 替换为 dogs。哪些 Q/K/V 量会改变？下一词元 sleep 的概率会怎样变化？
zh.challenge.3.local_increase: 只有被替换位置的 Q/K/V 改变；P(sleep) 增大
zh.challenge.3.local_decrease: 只有被替换位置的 Q/K/V 改变；P(sleep) 减小
zh.challenge.3.all_increase: 所有位置的 Q/K/V 都改变；P(sleep) 增大
zh.challenge.4.label: 4 · 温度迁移
zh.challenge.4.prompt: 固定情境：保持 logits 不变，把温度从 T=0.5 提高到 T=2.0。概率分布会怎样变化？
zh.challenge.committed: 已锁定预测：{prediction}。在点击“揭示机制”之前，机制仍保持隐藏。
zh.challenge.1.explain: 这个排序来自查询与键的缩放点积，再经过 softmax；它不是对某种“语义意图”的标记。
zh.challenge.1.transfer: 在使用 Q/K 扰动情境之前，先预测：如果某个查询或键的分量改变，哪个分数会随之改变？
zh.challenge.2.mechanism: 移除掩码后，目标位置 i @ 1 会把总计 {percent}% 的注意力分配给后面的来源位置。
zh.challenge.2.explain: 自回归语义要求：从前缀进行预测时，位置 1 不能依赖位置 2 或 3。
zh.challenge.2.transfer: 重新启用掩码并检查同一行：后面的单元格会在结构上变为不可用（屏蔽）。
zh.challenge.3.mechanism: 较早位置的 Q/K/V 最大 Δ = {earlier}；被替换位置的 Q/K/V 最大 Δ = {changed}。P(sleep)：{before} → {after}；Δ = {delta}。
zh.challenge.3.explain: 在投影阶段，只有被替换位置的输入发生变化，因此该位置的 Q/K/V 会改变，而更早位置的 Q/K/V 保持不变。之后的注意力混合与最终 logits 仍可能因此改变。
zh.challenge.3.transfer: 把更早位置的一个词元替换掉，在查看矩阵之前先预测哪一行投影量会发生变化。
zh.challenge.4.mechanism: 熵：T=0.5 时为 {cold} → T=2.0 时为 {hot}。Logits 完全相同。
zh.challenge.4.explain: 用更高温度去除固定 logits，会减小它们之间的相对差距，然后再经过 softmax，因此这个分布会变得更平坦。
zh.challenge.4.transfer: 在不改变任何模型权重的前提下，预测把 T 降到 0.5 以下会发生什么。
zh.state.title: 可访问的数值状态
zh.state.description: 当前可视化状态的文本等价表示。
zh.summary.selected: 已选择位置 {position} 的 {token}。允许使用 {count} 个来源位置。位置向量：{positions}；因果掩码：{mask}；温度：{temperature}；扰动：{perturbation}。
zh.tokenizer.note: 玩具词元器：{pieces} 个表层片段 + <BOS>；{unknown} 个未知片段映射为 <UNK>{truncation}。这个受源文本约束的玩具词元器只是教学用固定机制，并不是通用词元器。
zh.tokenizer.truncation: ；上下文截断为 {max} 个词元，同时保留 <BOS>
zh.scenario.canonical.note: 标准流程：检查最终词元，并从词元 ID 开始逐步追踪固定算术，直到得到下一词元分布。
zh.scenario.qk.note: 扰动实验：把最终查询 q[0] 增加 0.50。cats 的缩放分数从 {score_before} 变为 {score_after}，对应注意力权重从 {weight_before} 变为 {weight_after}。这个扰动改变的是算术关系，不是所谓的语义意图。
zh.scenario.order.note: 顺序测试：开启位置信息时，交换 i/like 会改变最终分布（最大 Δ {with_positions}）；关闭位置信息时，在这个单注意力头固定机制中，同样的交换保持不变（最大 Δ {without_positions}）。
zh.scenario.mask.note: 掩码泄漏：在目标位置 i（位置 1），移除掩码后会把总计 {percent}% 的注意力分配给后面的来源位置。这违反了该位置的自回归依赖约束。
zh.scenario.temperature.note: 温度：T=0.5 时的熵为 {cold}，T=2.0 时升至 {hot}，同时 logits 保持不变。更高温度会让这个分布更平坦。
zh.scenario.explanation.note: 可执行反例：对于“sleep sleep i”，最终一行最大的注意力权重是 {weight_token}@{weight_position} = {weight}；然而，对原始最高概率词元（{top_token}）的 logit 做有限消融时，最大影响来自 {impact_token}@{impact_position} = {impact}。这里的消融是在不重新归一化的情况下移除一个 αⱼvⱼ 贡献。它只是用来反驳“最大注意力 = 原因”的诊断性反例，并不是完整的因果解释。
zh.misconceptions.title: 检查你对这个模型机制的理解
zh.misconception.1.claim: “一个 token 就是一个单词。”
zh.misconception.1.response: 一般不是。本 applet 使用刻意简化、受源文本约束的玩具词元器；未知单词映射为 <UNK>，句点本身也是一个词元。
zh.misconception.2.claim: “注意力告诉我们模型理解了什么。”
zh.misconception.2.response: 不是。注意力权重是数值混合系数，不能直接读出模型的理解。
zh.misconception.3.claim: “最大的注意力权重就是预测的原因。”
zh.misconception.3.response: 不是。值向量、残差路径、前馈变换和输出权重也都会影响 logits。
zh.misconception.4.response: 这里不会。这个 applet 不会发出网络请求，也不会调用检索机制。
zh.misconception.5.claim: “因果掩码会让模型忘掉它已经看过的未来词。”
zh.misconception.5.response: 掩码是一种结构性约束，用来规定某个目标位置可以使用哪些来源位置。
zh.misconception.6.claim: “温度会改变模型已经学到的权重。”
zh.misconception.6.response: 不会。温度只是在 softmax 之前重新缩放固定 logits。
zh.misconception.7.claim: “概率最高的词元总会被选中。”
zh.misconception.7.response: 概率分布与生成时的选择规则是两回事。
zh.misconception.8.response: 不是。位置向量为这个玩具表示加入依赖于位置的信息。
zh.misconception.9.claim: “模型会存储完整答案，然后把它们检索出来。”
zh.misconception.9.response: 这个 applet 根据数值状态计算 logits。检索是另一种机制。
